description: This script automates the process of rolling the BoringSSL third-party source code in Chromium's build system, updating dependencies, generating build files, and committing changes.

methods.name: IsPristine
methods.description: Checks if a git repository has uncommitted changes.

methods.name: RevParse
methods.description: Resolves a git revision string to a commit hash.

methods.name: UpdateDEPS
methods.description: Replaces old commit hash references with new ones in the DEPS file.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs between two revisions, parsing commit details.

methods.name: FormatCommit
methods.description: Formats a commit into a single-line string with hash and message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the rolling process, including updating dependencies, generating build files, and committing changes.
